description:
Configure a Parametric Run in eQUEST named 'Low-E Retrofit' that reduces the Solar Heat Gain Coefficient (SHGC) and U-value of ALL glass types in the 4StoreyBuilding model. 

Goal: Create a scenario to analyze high-performance windows without overwriting the baseline design.

Instructions:
1. Open the Parametric Runs tool (Tools > Parametric Runs).
2. Create a new Run (e.g., named 'Low-E Retrofit').
3. Add a Component Modification to this run targeting 'Glass Type'.
4. Apply the modification to ALL glass types (using wildcard '*' or the specific glass type name 'GT-1').
5. Set the new parameters: SHADING-COEF = 0.35 and GLASS-CONDUCTANCE = 0.28.
6. Run the simulation (Baseline + Parametric).
7. Save the project.

Important: Do NOT manually change the values of the glass types in the Component Tree; you must use the Parametric Runs feature to preserve the baseline.
